items.title: Voice volume stays excessively loud

before.summary: An October 9 Support reply adds another volume-slider report. The earlier 1.7 target remains unverified as a release.

proposed.summary: Patch 1.7 explicitly fixes voice-volume slider scaling across audio channels. Independent post-patch outcome testing is not recorded.

items.evidence: Voice-volume sliders now scale correctly across audio channels.
items.reason: The release notes explicitly name the slider defect, so its release status can advance.
items.caution: This evidence does not resolve separate voice-channel outages.

items.title: Running boat engines prevent spawning

before.summary: The revised proposal turns the engine off when a driver exits manually, not when killed. It may arrive in 1.7 or later; no release is confirmed.

proposed.summary: Patch 1.7 shuts the engine off on manual driver exit so the boat can become a spawn point. A killed driver deliberately leaves it running.

items.evidence: Manually leaving the driver seat stops the engine; a driver killed in the seat leaves it running.
items.reason: The revised manual-exit behavior has release evidence. Keep its trigger explicit in the summary.
items.caution: Driver-death behavior is intentional. Other boat replication problems remain separate.

items.title: Rubberbanding along shorelines

proposed.summary: Patch 1.7 reduces rubberbanding while walking or running along water edges; the wording does not promise elimination.

items.evidence: Rubberbanding is reduced when walking or running beside water.
items.reason: Add a scoped record for the shoreline improvement, using the degree of improvement the publisher describes.
items.caution: Reduced does not establish a complete fix.

items.title: Tutorial completion may not stay saved

before.summary: October 11 Support follow-up confirms continuing tutorial/reset reports were escalated. A completion-saving fix is still unconfirmed.

proposed.summary: Patch 1.7 clarifies tutorial completion labels. Saving lost completion progress is still not confirmed fixed.

items.reason: Record the relevant announcement while retaining the unresolved status of completion saving.
items.caution: A clearer label does not establish that saved progress now persists.

items.title: M1A1 Thompson

proposed.summary: Adds a US submachine-gun option to the listed roles.

items.evidence: The Thompson is available to ten specified US roles.
items.reason: Create a content record with the published role restrictions. The linked live record lists those roles.

items.title: ANZAC Forces

proposed.summary: Announced as an expansion of US & Allied Forces in Update 2.0; not released by Patch 1.7.

items.evidence: ANZAC Forces are planned for Update 2.0 in November.
items.reason: Track the announced expansion and its target separately from what this patch released.
items.caution: November is a target window; an exact launch day is not stated.
